validate: too long for one fact: Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "Indebtedness" of any Person means, without duplication, all indebtedness for borrowed money or deferred purchase price of property or services (including obligations with respect to surety bonds, letters of credit and bankers' acceptances, whether or not matured), all obligations evidenced by notes, bonds, debentures or similar instruments, all indebtedness under conditional sale or title retention agreements, all obligations under leases recorded as capital leases in accordance with GAAP, all net obligations under Hedging Agreements, all guaranties of such obligations, and all such Indebtedness secured (or for which the holder has a right to be secured) by any Lien on property owned by such Person even if the Person has not assumed liability for it, provided that Indebtedness supported by another type of Indebtedness is not counted more than once.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, not later than 11:00 a.m. (New York City time) two Business Days prior to the proposed date of Borrowing in the case of LIBOR Bid Loans, or on the date of the Bid Borrowing in the case of Absolute Rate Loans, the Borrower shall either cancel the Borrowing by giving the Administrative Agent and the Lenders notice (which may be given by telephone, confirmed by facsimile), or accept one or more of the offers made by any Lender in its sole discretion by giving notice to such Lender of the amount of each Bid Loan to be made, which shall be equal to or greater than the minimum amount and equal to or less than the maximum amount notified by such Lender, and reject any remaining offers, and give notice to the Administrative Agent of the date of the Borrowing and the aggregate amount thereof, which may not exceed the applicable amount set forth in the related Competitive Bid Request.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, if, other than as provided in Sections 3.05, 3.08, 3.09, 3.10 or 3.11, any Lender obtains any payment, whether voluntary, involuntary, through the exercise of any right of set-off or otherwise, on account of any Committed Loan made by it and, after acceleration of all Obligations pursuant to Section 8.02(b), in respect of any Obligation owing to it including with respect to any Bid Loan, in the case of the Committed Loan in excess of its Percentage Share of payments on account of the Committed Loans obtained by all the Lenders and, after acceleration, in excess of its pro rata share of all Obligations, such Lender shall forthwith notify the Administrative Agent of that fact and purchase from the other Lenders such participations in the Committed Loans made by them or, after acceleration, in all Obligations owing to them, as shall be necessary to cause the purchasing Lender to share the excess payment ratably with each of the other Lenders according to their respective Percentage Shares or, after acceleration, their pro rata shares of all the Obligations.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement between Tyson Foods and the Lenders, if any Lender or Issuing Bank determines that, due to (a) the introduction of any Requirement of Law or any change (other than a change by way of imposition of or increase in reserve requirements included in the Eurodollar Reserve Percentage) in or in the interpretation thereof, or (b) compliance with any guideline or request made after the date of the Agreement by any central bank or other Governmental Authority (whether or not having the force of law), there is any increase in the cost to that Lender or Issuing Bank of agreeing to make or making, funding or maintaining any Committed Loan or any Letter of Credit or participation therein, the Borrower is liable for, and must from time to time upon demand by that Lender or Issuing Bank (with a copy to the Administrative Agent), pay to the Administrative Agent for the account of that Lender or Issuing Bank additional amounts sufficient to compensate for the increased costs (other than costs for Taxes contemplated by Section 3.05 or reserve requirements contemplated by Section 3.06).

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement between Tyson Foods and the Lenders, if any Lender or Issuing Bank determines that the introduction of, or change in, any Requirement of Law regarding capital adequacy (including any change therein or in its interpretation or application, or any request or directive regarding capital adequacy, whether or not having the force of law, from any central bank or other Governmental Authority), or compliance therewith by that Lender or Issuing Bank (or its Lending Office) or any corporation controlling it, affects or would affect the amount of capital required or expected to be maintained by that Lender or Issuing Bank or any controlling corporation, and that Lender or Issuing Bank (taking into consideration its or the corporation's capital adequacy policies and desired return on capital) determines that the amount of such capital is increased as a consequence of its Commitment, loans or obligations under the Agreement with respect to any Committed Borrowing or any Letters of Credit, then from time to time upon demand of that Lender or Issuing Bank (with a copy to the Administrative Agent), the Borrower is liable for, and must pay to the Administrative Agent for the account of that Lender or Issuing Bank as specified, additional amounts sufficient to compensate for that increase.
validate: cites no passage: Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "Existing Letters of Credit" means each letter of credit issued by a Lender in its capacity as an "Issuing Bank" under the Existing 2004 Five-Year Credit Agreement for the account of the Borrower that is outstanding on the date of the agreement (September 28, 2005) and is identified in writing by the Borrower to the Administrative Agent as an Existing Letter of Credit on or before that date.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement between Tyson Foods and the Administrative Agent, the Borrower must promptly notify the Administrative Agent of all actions, suits and proceedings before any court or other Governmental Authority affecting the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries that have any reasonable likelihood of having a Material Adverse Effect.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, the Borrower (Tyson Foods) shall not, and shall not permit any of its Subsidiaries to, engage to any substantial extent in any business other than the production, marketing and distribution of food products and any related food or agricultural products, processes or business.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, no failure on the part of any Lender or the Administrative Agent to exercise, and no delay in exercising, any right, remedy, power or privilege under the agreement or any other Loan Document shall operate as a waiver thereof, nor shall any single or partial exercise preclude any other or further exercise or the exercise of any other right, remedy, power or privilege.
Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, the remedies provided in the agreement are cumulative and not exclusive of any remedies provided by law.
decision_floors.grounded: Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "Consolidated Net Income Available for Restricted Payments" equals the sum of $150,000,000 plus 80% (or minus 100% in case of consolidated net loss) of Consolidated Net Income for the period commencing October 3, 2004 and terminating at the fiscal quarter end of the Borrower immediately preceding the date of any proposed Restricted Payment.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "Priority Debt" means any Indebtedness secured by a Lien (including in connection with capital leases or other financing leases) encumbering any asset of the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries.
Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "Priority Debt" means any sale-leaseback transaction involving assets of the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries.
Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, the Receivables Facility must be in full force and effect as a condition to effectiveness.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, if any investigation, litigation, suit, action or proceeding is asserted or threatened in writing or instituted against an Indemnified Party, or any remedial, removal or response action is requested of it, for which the Administrative Agent, the Syndication Agent, any Documentation Agent, any Co-Documentation Agent or any Lender or Issuing Bank may desire indemnity or defense, that party shall promptly notify the Borrower in writing.
decision_floors.atomic: Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, a "Material Acquisition" means any acquisition or series of related acquisitions of property that constitutes all or substantially all of the Stock or assets of any Person or all or substantially all of any operating unit of a business and involves consideration in excess of $500,000,000, and a "Material Disposition" means any sale, transfer, lease or other disposition or series of related dispositions of property that constitutes all or substantially all of the Stock or assets of a Subsidiary of the Borrower or all or substantially all of any operating unit of a business of the Borrower or its Subsidiaries and yields gross proceeds to the Borrower or its Subsidiaries in excess of $500,000,000.
Amendment No. 2 to the Tyson Foods Five-Year Credit Agreement is dated as of April 28, 2006 and amends the Tyson Foods, Inc. Five-Year Credit Agreement dated as of September 28, 2005.

Under the Financing Agreement of Life Sciences Research, there are no outstanding debt or equity securities of the Parent or any of its Subsidiaries and no outstanding obligations of the Parent or any of its Subsidiaries convertible into or exchangeable for, or warrants, options or other rights for the purchase or acquisition from the Parent or any of its Subsidiaries, or other obligations of any Subsidiary to issue, directly or indirectly, any shares of Capital Stock of any Subsidiary of the Parent.

Under the First Amendment to the Life Sciences Research Financing Agreement, the Guarantors and Borrower release the Lender Parties from all claims, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the Amendment, the Financing Agreement, any other Loan Document, and related transactions and agreements, based on acts or omissions occurring at or prior to and including the date of the Amendment.
decision_floors.useful: Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "IRS" means the Internal Revenue Service of the United States of America.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "Person" means an individual, partnership, corporation, business trust, joint stock company, trust, unincorporated association, joint venture or Governmental Authority.
Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "US Dollars" or "US$" refers to lawful money of the United States of America.
Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, the words "includes" and "including" are not exclusive and mean "includes, without limitation" and "including, without limitation."

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, the headings of the agreement are inserted for convenience only and do not affect the meaning or interpretation of the agreement or any of its provisions.
decision_floors.attribution: Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "Priority Debt" means any Indebtedness secured by a Lien (including in connection with capital leases or other financing leases) encumbering any asset of the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries.
Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, "Priority Debt" means any sale-leaseback transaction involving assets of the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries.

Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement of Tyson Foods, the Administrative Agent must receive, together with TFM's executed counterpart of the Guarantee Agreement, such documents and certificates as the Administrative Agent or its counsel may reasonably request relating to the organization, existence and good standing of TFM and the authorization of the Transactions to which TFM is party.
Agstar Financial Services, PCA, as a Lender, executed Amendment No. 2 to the Tyson Foods Five-Year Credit Agreement through Troy Mostaert, Vice President.

Under the Note Purchase Agreement between Furniture Brands International and the purchasers, the purchaser and each subsequent holder of a Note agree to release any Subsidiary Guarantor from the Subsidiary Guaranty if (i) such Subsidiary Guarantor ceases to be such as a result of an Asset Disposition or other transaction permitted by Section 10.6 or 10.7, or (ii) such Subsidiary is released as a guarantor under and in respect of the Credit Agreement.
decision_floors.distinct: Under the amended Applicable Rate definition in the Five-Year Credit Agreement, if the rating system of Moody's or S&P changes or either agency ceases rating corporate debt obligations, Tyson Foods, Inc. and the Lenders must negotiate in good faith to amend the definition, and pending such amendment the Applicable Rate is determined by reference to the rating most recently in effect before the change or cessation.
JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. serves as administrative agent under the Five-Year Credit Agreement.

Under the amended Applicable Rate definition in the Five-Year Credit Agreement, each change in the Applicable Rate applies from the effective date of that change until the day before the effective date of the next change.
CoBank, ACB and U.S. AgBank, FCB serve as co-documentation agents under the Five-Year Credit Agreement.
SunTrust Bank, Coöperatieve Centrale Raiffeisen-Boerenleenbank B.A. ("Rabobank International"), New York Branch, and BNP Paribas serve as documentation agents under the Five-Year Credit Agreement.
